rounds.caseSet: CN-01 input patched to 大学物理 / 周五 5-6 节 / 实验楼301; other 11 cases unchanged
rounds.review: agent review on explicit user instruction; not a human review

findings: A group converts 'clear all data' into DELETE_COURSE for every current course in both rounds, and the strict local validator accepts it both times.
B group showed that candidate only in round 2, so single-sample behaviour is not stable and no stability claim is allowed.
Round-1 CN-01 zeros were caused by the fixture colliding with the fixed synthetic context; patching the input in round 2 produced correct proposals in both groups.
parsePlannerReply splits one batch action carrying courseIds[2,3,4] into three proposals, which breaks expected-action-count assertions.
limitations: single model, single pass per case, no temperature/seed control, no repetition
no provider usage metadata; tokenUsage and estimatedCost are null and are not inferred
semantic scoring is rubric-based human or agent review, not a metric computed from the model output
costNote: Round 1: balance 18.04 -> 16.74 CNY between runs, about 1.30 CNY for 24 requests. Round 2 delta measured 0 because platform billing lags; read the usage page for the exact figure.
